article_title: B.C. Reg. 156/2026 – British Columbia Securities Commission
body:
Regulation: B.C. Reg. 156/2026
Made under: Securities Act
Published in: No. 16 – B.C. Regs. 153 to 162, September 22, including September 8, 2026
Deposit date: September 11, 2026

B.C. Reg. 156/2026, deposited September 11, 2026, under theSECURITIES ACT[section 184]. Rule of the British Columbia Securities Commission, dated September 11, 2026. The British Columbia Securities Commission orders that, effective September 22, 2026, (a)	National Instrument 51-102Continuous Disclosure Obligations, B.C. Reg. 110/2004, is amended as set out in the attached Schedule A, and (b)	National Instrument 54-101Communication with Beneficial Owners of Securities of a Reporting Issuer, B.C. Reg. 154/2002, is amended as set out in the attached Schedule B. — B. LEONG,British Columbia Securities Commission. 1	National Instrument 51-102Continuous Disclosure Obligations, B.C. Reg. 110/2004, is amended as set out in this Schedule A. 2	The following sections are added: Electronic access to annual financial statements 4.5.1(1)	Subsections (2) and (3) do not apply to a reporting issuer that complies with subsection 4.6 (1) or meets the conditions in subsection 4.6 (5). (2)	If, during the previous financial period, a reporting issuer complied with subsection 4.6 (1) or met the conditions in subsection 4.6 (5), the reporting issuer must, at least 25 calendar days before it issues and files the news release referred to in subsection (3), issue and file a news release that states (a)	in the title that the annual financial statements and MD&A relating to the annual financial statements will be accessible through SEDAR+, and (b)	substantially the following: "Electronic access to documents [Insert name of reporting issuer]’s annual financial statements and annual MD&A will be accessible electronically on SEDAR+ at www.sedarplus.com, the official site to access public documents filed by issuers with Canadian securities regulators. SEDAR+ allows a person or company to sign up to receive email notifications of a reporting issuer’s financial statement and MD&A filings. If you would like to be notified when [insert name of reporting issuer] files its financial statements and MD&A on SEDAR+, you can sign up to receive email notifications at www.sedarplus.com. The notification includes a direct link to those documents. Obtaining a copy of the documents If you hold securities of [insert name of reporting issuer] that are not debt instruments, you can obtain from [insert name of reporting issuer], without charge, an electronic or paper copy of its annual financial statements and annual MD&A by providing your email address or mailing address to [insert contact information for reporting issuer]. If you hold securities of [insert name of reporting issuer] that are not debt instruments and have provided standing instructions to receive those documents electronically or by mail in accordance with securities legislation, those documents will continue to be sent to you based on your instructions until you change them." (3)	A reporting issuer must, not more than one calendar day after the filing on SEDAR+ of its annual financial statements and MD&A relating to the annual financial statements under section 4.1 or 4.10 and section 5.1, issue and file a news release on SEDAR+ that states (a)	in the title that the annual financial statements and MD&A relating to the annual financial statements are accessible through SEDAR+, and

minutes_briefs.title: BC public companies must now file a news release 25 days before annual financial statements
minutes_briefs.summary: B.C. Reg. 156/2026 changes the rules for reporting issuers (public companies whose securities trade in Canada) under National Instrument 51-102. Starting September 22, 2026, a company that used electronic delivery of its annual financial statements in the previous year must issue and file a news release at least 25 calendar days before it files its annual financial statements and MD&A (management's discussion and analysis — the company's own explanation of its results). The release must say in its title that the documents will be available on SEDAR+ (the official website where companies file public documents) and include set wording about how investors can sign up for email alerts and request copies. A second news release must be filed within one calendar day after the statements are filed. Related amendments to National Instrument 54-101, which deals with communicating with the real owners of shares held through brokers, are also included.
minutes_briefs.action_required: If you are a reporting issuer that used electronic delivery last year, prepare and file the required SEDAR+ news release at least 25 days before your annual financial statements are due.

key_dates.label: BC Reg. 156/2026 electronic access news release rule takes effect
